reviewMethod: Root read all first drafts and author maps; independent reviewers checked each brief/first draft/protocol. Seven P2 project-document findings, followed by one root correction pass; no original draft modified.

findings.heading: Forms, editing, and navigation
findings.issue: Create editor lacks stable target and update semantics after A succeeds while B remains dirty.
findings.correction: Reserve target identity per editor; bind post-create edits to that record and use Save changes, preserving original completion identity/date.

findings.heading: Forms, editing, and navigation
findings.issue: Durable draft Discard does not retire queued autosaves or define failure.
findings.correction: Transactionally retire non-reused draft identity at completion; reject old autosaves, retain failure context and distinguish temporary-only discard.

findings.heading: Storage failures, deletion, and recovery
findings.issue: Plan removal and Undo lack focus targets.
findings.correction: If still in the affected context, focus next/previous/Week after remove and restored entry after Undo; failures retain trigger/context.

findings.heading: Inputs, component states, and feedback
findings.issue: Repeated Add to existing variant has no merge/range semantics.
findings.correction: One line per stable variant; add requested amount to current acknowledged quantity with candidate revision checks; reject excessive result without clamp.

findings.heading: Quote review and hosted checkout
findings.issue: Earlier-attempt matching reply and observation ordering are implicit.
findings.correction: Accept authoritative same-action/payload/quote evidence under service ordering; prevent regression; add ordering to G2.

findings.heading: Quote review and hosted checkout
findings.issue: Hosted return and browser re-entry have no concrete reconciliation/landing flow.
findings.correction: G2 defines return reference/method; recover original action, reconcile on return or restored page, preserve current cart and gate overlaps; define contextual focus.

findings.heading: 8. Submission, uncertain outcomes and external gates
findings.issue: Dispatch names G1/G5 while recovery decision remains separately optional G2.
findings.correction: Dispatch also requires explicit G2 capability decision, with acknowledged identity/independent discovery or approved, accurately limited reduced capability.
